intro.title: Start here
intro.body:
This is the order things happen in. Every underlined term opens that page on the map, so you can dip into detail and come straight back.

You do not need to read it all. If you are already levelling, jump to the step you are on.

chapters.title: Find the Evaluator
chapters.goal: Get a class, a style and a rank
chapters.body:
Nothing in the mod opens until you are measured. Look for a **Hunter Rank Evaluator** and use it. The [[evaluation|Evaluation]] rolls three things: your [[classes|class]], your style within that class, and your [[ranks|Hunter rank]].

Class and style can both be rerolled as many times as you like before you accept. Your **rank cannot be rerolled** — so if you are chasing a specific rank, your only lever is the world settings that control the odds.

Take your time here. Accepting is what grants your first abilities, and nothing is handed out until you do.
checklist: Reroll class and style freely — it costs nothing
Rank is fixed once rolled, so accept deliberately
Nothing is granted until you press accept

chapters.title: Learn what you actually have
chapters.goal: Understand your panel and your first skills
chapters.body:
Press **N** to open the System panel. This is where everything lives: your stats, your skill points, your quests and your class information.

Your style decides your native ability tree, not just a damage bonus. A [[classes|Fighter]] running one style plays nothing like the same class running another. Read your style page before you spend anything.

To fight: **R** toggles combat mode, and **1** through **8** use whatever ability is equipped in that slot. **Z** flips to your second page of equipped skills, so you have sixteen within reach. **X, C, V and B** are fixed quick keys - Melee, Ruler's Authority, Dash and Aura - and cannot be reassigned. Full list on the [[keybinds|Keybinds]] page.
checklist: R toggles combat mode
1-8 use the ability in that slot; Z flips to page two
X Melee, C Ruler's Authority, V Dash, B Aura - all fixed

chapters.title: Clear your first gates
chapters.goal: Learn the loop and start levelling
chapters.body:
[[gates|Gates]] are rifts that open into instanced dungeons. Each carries a [[gate-ranks|rank]] from E to S, and the rank tells you how hard what is inside will hit.

Start at the bottom. E and D gates exist to teach you the loop: go in, clear it, take the reward, come out. Mine any [[mana-crystals|mana crystals]] you find — Silk Touch preserves the deposit and Fortune increases the yield.

Watch your [[fatigue|Fatigue]]. It builds as you fight and it does not care that you were winning.
checklist: Start with E and D gates, not what looks impressive
Fortune increases mana crystal yield
Fatigue builds while you fight

chapters.title: Level up and spend your points
chapters.body:
Every level costs `level x 16 + 8` XP, which means the total to reach level N is exactly `8 x N squared`. The curve is gentle early and steep late.

Each level gives you **3 skill points** to spend in the panel. Points go into Strength, Vitality, Agility, Sense and Intelligence, and what those do depends heavily on how you fight — an Intelligence point is worth far more to a Mage than to a Tanker.

There is a ceiling: the default level cap is **150**, and reaching it is what reopens the [[cartenon-temple|Cartenon Temple]] for the last time.
checklist: 3 skill points per level
Default level cap is 150
Hitting the cap reopens the Cartenon Temple

chapters.title: Claim the System at the Cartenon Temple
chapters.goal: Lose to the Statue of God on purpose
chapters.body:
Getting a job at the Evaluation made you a Hunter. The [[cartenon-temple|Cartenon Temple]] is what makes you a **Player**, and it is **guaranteed to appear within your first three gates** - so this happens early, ready or not.

When the summons is up, **hold crouch on the ground for two seconds** to answer it. Particles confirm it is counting; releasing resets it.

Then fight [[statue-of-god|the Statue of God]] and **lose**. That is the intended outcome. The temple will not actually let you die on this first visit - the killing blow is intercepted and the System asks whether you want to become a Player instead. Say yes and you are pulled back to the overworld, awakened.

Not ready? **Hold crouch for four seconds** to withdraw. The summons re-opens and you lose nothing.
checklist: Guaranteed within your first 3 gates
Hold crouch 2 seconds to answer the summons
You are meant to lose - the killing blow becomes the awakening offer
Hold crouch 4 seconds to withdraw and try later

chapters.title: Make Daily Quests a habit
chapters.body:
The System starts setting you [[daily-quests|Daily Quests]]. They reset every day and they are the most reliable progression in the mod.

They are not optional in spirit. **Failing a daily carries a penalty**, and the penalty is designed to be unpleasant enough that you remember it. If your world has punishment switched off in the settings, this is much gentler.

While you are out clearing gates, keep an eye out for [[urgent-quests|Urgent Quests]] — timed objectives that fire mid-dungeon, more often inside [[red-gates|Red Gates]] and procedural dungeons.
checklist: Dailies reset every day
Failing one carries a penalty
Urgent Quests trigger mid-dungeon for extra rewards

chapters.title: Take the Job Change trial
chapters.body:
At level **40** — adjustable between 20 and 100 in world settings — the [[job-change-quest|Job Change Quest]] becomes available. This is the biggest decision in the mod.

Passing it lets you take a [[vessels|Vessel]]: the inherited power of a Monarch or a Ruler. [[monarchs|Monarchs]] give you a themed skill tree that unlocks as you level. Rulers hand you their Spiritual Body Manifestation immediately and unlock shared Ruler abilities afterward.

The [[shadow-monarch|Shadow Monarch]] is the one most people come for — it is the path that lets you [[shadow-extraction|extract shadows]] from things you kill and build an army out of them.
checklist: Level 40 by default, configurable 20-100
Monarchs unlock over time, Rulers start with their manifestation
Shadow Monarch is the extraction path

chapters.title: Grow into your Vessel
chapters.goal: Unlock the tree you just committed to
chapters.body:
Vessel abilities are level-gated on a shared ladder: **55, 60, 65, 70, 75, 85, 90, 95, 100**, and finally **120** for [[spiritual-body-manifestation|Spiritual Body Manifestation]].

If you took the Shadow Monarch, your other axis of growth is the army itself — [[shadow-storage|how many shadows you can hold]], [[shadow-ranks|what rank they climb to]], and [[shadow-types|which ones you can get]]. Bosses you beat are candidates for extraction.

Alongside this, [[runestones|runestones]] teach abilities permanently. The important rule: **a runestone works even when the ability does not belong to your class or style.** Your style decides what you are natively given, not what you are allowed to learn.
checklist: Vessel skills unlock at fixed levels from 55 to 120
Runestones ignore class and style restrictions
Shadows grow their own ranks alongside you

chapters.title: Earn the key, climb the castle
chapters.goal: Twenty floors and the Demon King
chapters.gate: Secret Quest at level 30+, then the climb
chapters.body:
The [[secret-quest|Secret Quest]] becomes available from level 30 and is how you get the key to the [[demon-kings-castle|Demon King's Castle]] — a twenty-floor tower that is the mod's long endgame.

The floors escalate. [[dkc-vulcans-crucible|Vulcan]] holds Floor 10. Floor 15 puts a genuine choice in front of you at Radiru Castle: make a pact, or take what you want by force. At the summit, Baran waits with Kaiselin.

If you get stuck inside, you are not trapped: `/slr stuck` returns you to the current floor's entrance and `/slr dkc leave` abandons the castle while keeping your completed floors.
checklist: Secret Quest unlocks at level 30
Twenty floors, with a real choice on Floor 15
/slr stuck and /slr dkc leave get you out safely

chapters.title: The far end
chapters.goal: Manifestation, the cap, and what is left
chapters.body:
[[spiritual-body-manifestation|Spiritual Body Manifestation]] is the top of every Vessel tree. For the Shadow Monarch specifically it wants four things at once: level **120**, shadow storage usage of **60**, Shadow Exchange unlocked, and **10** floors of the Demon King's Castle cleared.

Beyond that sit the things that do not follow the main line. [[red-gates|Red Gates]] are frozen worlds you cannot simply walk out of. [[monarch-territories|Monarch Territories]] open onto the domains of individual Monarchs. And the hardest fights in the mod — [[boss-monarch|Monarch-tier bosses]] — are waiting whenever you think you are ready.

The climb ends at level **150**, which reopens the [[cartenon-temple|Cartenon Temple]] one last time.
checklist: Shadow Manifestation needs all four conditions, not just level 120
Red Gates have no easy exit
Level 150 is the summit and reopens the Cartenon Temple
